title: Boss Levels
description: One realistic refactor per level, each several steps long. Nothing new here: everything you've learned, and the order you use it in.

levels.title: Spreadsheet to docs
levels.description: Turn this CSV into a Markdown table, with the rows sorted by year and a |---|---|---| line under the header.
levels.hint: Sort first, while the data is simple: :sor n sorts by the first number on each line, and a line with no number stays on top. Then two :s commands build the table.

levels.title: Private parts
levels.description: Make every field of this class private (#name), and add a getter for each one, after a blank line, in the same order.
levels.hint: A block insert does the first step. Then copy the fields, and turn the copies into getters with :s on a line range. & already holds #name;

levels.title: Modern modules
levels.description: Move this file from require to import. Sort the imports by name, and turn the last line into a named export with the same list.
start_text: module.exports = { path, fs, os, zlib, http }

value: export { path, fs, os, zlib, http }

levels.hint: A range keeps :sort away from the rest of the file. Then capture the two names with \v groups, and leave out what you don't need.

levels.title: Single source of truth
levels.description: The host and port are repeated everywhere. Add HOST and PORT constants after the import, with a blank line before and after them, and use them in each call.
levels.hint: Nothing clever about the constants: type them. The calls are one :%s, and the numbers in timeout= must survive it.

levels.title: Extract function
levels.description: report() mixes up adding and printing. Pull the adding out into a sum(orders) above it, as in the goal, with a blank line between the two.
levels.hint: Copy the whole function first. Then each copy needs only a small change: S replaces a line and keeps its indent, and d with a count removes the loop.

levels.title: Release notes
levels.description: Turn this git log into release notes: features first, then fixes, with the headings shown, and no chores. Each line loses its hash and its type. Careful: a commit message can hold a colon of its own.
start_text: d4e5f6 fix: crash on empty file
1f2e3d feat: daily: one level a day
levels.hint: Do it in order: :g deletes the chores and moves the fixes to the end, then add the headings, then one lazy :%s strips the prefixes.

levels.title: Bulk insert
levels.description: Turn these rows into one SQL statement, with the names and roles quoted, as in the goal.
levels.hint: Add the first line while you're up there. The rows are all the same shape, so record one, and let a macro beat the regex. The last line needs its own ending.
